title: Monkeypox Virus Multiplexed PCR Amplicon Sequencing (PrimalSeq)
author: Nicholas F.G. Chen*
materials: *Safe Stopping Point: Amplified DNA may remain in the thermocycler at 4°C or stored at -20°C until ready to use*
Once the thermocycler reaches 10 °C , remove tubes/plates and spin down
Immediately add 10 µL of TSB to each tube/well to stop reaction. Pipette to mix. Cap tube (or seal plate) and place back in thermocycler
Reagents: Primers should be ordered lyophilized or resuspended (100 uM; recommended). Lyophilized primers should be resuspended to 100 uM in nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Separate odd and even numbered primer pairs into two separate boxes (Pool 1: odd; Pool 2: even).

substeps.instruction: Label 164 8-strip tubes with corresponding odd-numbered primer names.
Add 90 µL nuclease-free water to each tube to create a 10X dilution (final concentration 10uM).
For each odd primer: spin down, mix by pipetting 10 times, and add 10 µL to the corresponding labeled tube; mix by pipetting 10 times.
Combine 10 µL from each of the 164 tubes into a single 2mL tube to create the odd-numbered primer pool.
Repeat the process for even-numbered primers (note: there are two fewer primers in the even set).

steps.title: Perform Tiling PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare and run the tiling PCR for Pool 1 and Pool 2.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mixes in two separate tubes (multiply volumes by reaction number).
Label PCR tubes/plates for Pool 1 and Pool 2.
Add 20 µL Pool 1 master mix to Pool 1 tubes and 20 µL Pool 2 master mix to Pool 2 tubes.
Add 5 µL DNA to each tube in both sets; mix by pipetting 10 times and briefly centrifuge.
Include a negative PCR control (NTC; nuclease-free water) for each pool.
Run the MPx Tiling PCR program on a thermocycler with the preheat lid option.
Spin down PCR tubes/plates after completion.

steps.title: Purify and Pool Amplicons
steps.instruction: Clean up and combine the PCR amplicons using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 400 µL of 80% EtOH per sample.
Allow AMPure XP beads to reach room temperature for 30 minutes and vortex to resuspend.
Add 50 µL AMPure XP beads to new PCR tubes/wells and mix by pipetting 10 times; spin down.
Add 25 µL Pool 1 amplicons and 25 µL Pool 2 amplicons to each tube; mix by pipetting 10 times (perform on a dedicated post-PCR bench).
Cap tubes/seal plate and shake at 1800 rpm for 10 minutes at RT.
Place on magnetic stand until supernatant is clear, then carefully discard supernatant.
Wash beads by covering pellet with 200 µL 80% EtOH; incubate for 30 seconds, then remove and discard EtOH.
Repeat the wash for a total of two washes.
Remove all residual 80% EtOH with a clean pipette tip.
Dry beads on the magnetic stand for 1-5 minutes until a matte appearance is achieved.
Remove from stand, add 32 µL nuclease-free water to resuspend beads, and mix by pipetting.
Shake on orbital shaker at 1800 rpm for 5 minutes at RT.
Place on magnetic stand until supernatant is clear and colorless (~2 min).
Transfer 32 µL of supernatant to a new tube/well as the purified sample.

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified DNA and adjust concentrations to 100-500 ng.

substeps.instruction: Quantify sample using the Qubit 1x dsDNA HS kit on the Qubit Flex Fluorometer.
If concentration is 20-100 ng/µL: add 5 µL sample to 25 µL dH2O.
If concentration is <20 ng/µL or >100 ng/µL: calculate volume to input at least 100 ng and add dH2O to reach 30 µL total.
For Negative Extraction Controls: add 5 µL sample plus 25 µL dH2O (concentration should be ≤5 ng/µL).
For NTCs: add 30 µL dH2O.

steps.title: Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation of the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Enhance PCR Mix (EPM), IDT Illumina Nextera DNA UD Indexes, samples, Bead-Linked Transposomes (BLT), and Tagmentation Buffer (TB1) on a cold block; vortex and spin.
Prepare tag master mix in a 1.5 mL tube; vortex, spin, and keep on cold block.
In a new tube/well, add 20 µL Tag master mix and 30 µL adjusted sample (100-500 ng); pipette 10 times to mix.
Cap/seal, gently vortex, and spin down.
Incubate at 55 °C for 15 minutes and hold at 10 °C using the Flex Tagment Program.
Vortex and spin Tagment Stop Buffer (TSB).
Remove tubes from thermocycler, quick spin, and place on cold block.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes and hold at 10 °C using the Flex Post-Tag program.

steps.title: Tagmentation Cleanup
steps.instruction: Wash the tagmented DNA using Tagment Wash Buffer (TWB).

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on magnetic stand until supernatant is clear (~2 minutes) and discard supernatant.
Slowly add 100 µL TWB directly onto beads and slowly pipette 10 times to mix (do not vortex).
Place on magnetic stand until supernatant is clear (~2 minutes) and discard supernatant.
Add another 100 µL TWB and slowly pipette to mix.
Cap/seal and leave on magnetic stand until the next step.

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the tagmented DNA using Flex Amplify master mix and indexes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Flex Amplify master mix in a 1.5 mL lo-bind tube; vortex, spin, and place on cold block.
Discard TWB supernatant from the tagmentation tubes.
Remove tubes from stand and place on cold block.
Immediately add 40 µL Flex Amplify master mix to the DNA.
Add 10 µL assigned Illumina Nextera DNA UD Indexes (or IDT for Illumina DNA/RNA UD Index).
Shake at 1600 rpm for 1 minute and quick spin.
Incubate using the Flex Amplify program (cycle number X determined by total DNA input).

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup of the amplified libraries using IPB beads.

substeps.instruction: Allow Sample Purification beads (SPB/IPB) to reach room temperature for 30 minutes; vortex and invert.
Thaw Resuspension Buffer (RSB) to RT; vortex and spin.
Add 81 µL undiluted IPB to new tubes/wells.
Remove amplified samples from thermocycler, quick spin, and place on magnetic stand for 2-5 minutes until clear.
Transfer 45 µL of sample supernatant into the tubes containing IPB; discard original tubes.
Cap/seal and shake at 1600 rpm for 1 minute on an orbital shaker.
Incubate on benchtop at RT for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for ~2 minutes until supernatant is clear and discard supernatant.
Wash beads by covering pellet with 200 µL 80% EtOH; incubate for 30 seconds, then remove and discard EtOH.
Repeat the wash for a total of two washes.
Remove residual 80% EtOH with a clean pipette tip.
Dry beads on magnetic stand for 1-5 minutes until matte appearance is achieved.
Resuspend beads with 32 µL RSB; shake at 1600 rpm for 1 minute on orbital shaker.
Incubate on benchtop at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for ~2 minutes until clear; remove 32 µL of supernatant into a new tube/well.

steps.title: Pooling and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Pool the purified libraries and perform final quantification.

substeps.instruction: Quantify libraries via Qubit or pool equal volumes of each sample (5 µL each) into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Quantify the final pooled library on a Qubit and obtain fragment distribution using a Bioanalyzer or TapeStation (refer to Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit Guide).
